svg.title: Kern Fig. 24 — tube-side heat-transfer curve
svg.text: L/D family redrawn from jH = 1.86 (Re·D/L)1/3 (laminar) and jH = 0.027 Re0.8 (turbulent)
Mark Ret = 9250 on the Re axis (4 passes; transition region).
Go straight up to the L/D = 310 curve (between the printed 240 and 500).
Go across to the jH axis.
Read jH ≈ 35 (the solution’s chart reading; the redrawn blend gives 40 —
the curves are still converging on the turbulent line here).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
